tips.text: Join a clan of level 10 or higher through recruit chat; it will have the Tenno Lab done. Skip clans demanding donations.
Run your own Ghost-tier solo clan if you prefer; its research costs are the cheapest in the game.
Buy the blueprint while you are in a clan whose Tenno Lab has finished the research; once bought it stays yours if you leave.
Research Nami Skyla first; it takes 48 hours, then the Guandao takes 72, and neither can be rushed.
Expect minutes of effort plus the 12 hour build, or about five extra days if you research it yourself.
